description: The conversation table of contents shows timeline images as thumbnails. /c/{{INLINE}} is a conversation whose agent shows an image inline in its reply; /c/{{TOOL}} is one whose agent took a screenshot with its browser tool. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{INLINE}}. 2. The first ".message-agent img" ("the inline image") should be visible (allow 30s). 3. Click ".toc-button". 4. In ".toc-popover", the ".toc-entry-eot" containing "Verified against the real product" should hold a visible ".toc-entry-thumbnail" whose src attribute is exactly the inline image's src attribute. 5. Press Escape. 6. Navigate to /c/{{TOOL}}. 7. The first ".screenshot-tool img" ("the tool image") should be visible (allow 30s); remember its src attribute in a window variable. 8. Click the first ".screenshot-tool-header": the tool image should be hidden (collapsed). 9. Click ".toc-button". 10. The first ".toc-popover .toc-entry-image" ("the tool entry") should hold a visible ".toc-entry-thumbnail" whose src attribute is exactly the remembered src. 11. Click the tool entry: ".toc-popover" should be hidden, the URL should come to match /#t-[a-zA-Z0-9]+$/, and the first ".screenshot-tool" should have the class "message-highlight".

steps.expression: (() => { const entries = [...document.querySelectorAll(".toc-popover .toc-entry-eot")].filter(e => e.textContent.includes("Verified against the real product")); if (entries.length !== 1) return "entries: " + entries.length; const t = entries[0].querySelector(".toc-entry-thumbnail"); if (!t || !t.checkVisibility()) return "no visible thumbnail"; return t.getAttribute("src") === window._inlineSrc; })()

(() => { const entry = document.querySelector(".toc-popover .toc-entry-image"); const t = entry && entry.querySelector(".toc-entry-thumbnail"); if (!t || !t.checkVisibility()) return "no visible thumbnail"; return t.getAttribute("src") === window._toolSrc; })()
